content.short: DragonSwap is a leading decentralized exchange and automated market maker built on the Sei blockchain.
content.description: DragonSwap is a premier decentralized finance protocol natively built on the Sei network, designed to provide users with a high-speed and low-cost trading experience. As a core AMM within the Sei ecosystem, DragonSwap utilizes the network's specialized infrastructure to offer near-instant transaction finality and minimal slippage across a wide variety of digital assets. The platform features an intuitive interface for swaps, liquidity provision, and yield farming, empowering users to maximize their capital efficiency. By prioritizing security and community-driven growth, DragonSwap acts as a critical liquidity hub, fostering innovation and asset diversity within the rapidly expanding Sei Layer 1 landscape.
content.meta: DragonSwap is the leading DEX on the Sei network, offering high-speed decentralized trading and optimized liquidity management for Web3 users.
